//: ONE file drives a whole video. Edit the values, keep the keys. Any key that starts with // is a comment. Fields: `mp list`; schema: templates/_shared/project.schema.json.
//how: mp new ad,proof-film ~/Movies/fernwick --project examples/project.example.json   then   cd ~/Movies/fernwick && mp render && mp check
//honesty: Fernwick is a FICTIONAL demo brand made for this example. The footage is the pack's own render plates; the product slot is a labelled placeholder; every proof-film number is a labelled placeholder (ILLUSTRATIVE in frame).
//template: the templates this project builds (`mp build` / `mp render` do every one; --template ad picks one). Same brand, same copy, each template uses the fields it knows.

brand.//: colours came from `mp brand examples/project-assets/fernwick-mark.svg`: accent from the mark, ink and paper tinted toward it, all three contrast-checked (WCAG).
brand.name: Fernwick

text.//: ALL on-screen copy. *word* = the accent word. Keep a read line to about 6 words; a digit needs a claim with a source (see claims).
text.headline: Every note, *found*.
text.promise: A fictional product. Every number in this film is a placeholder.
text.end: Replace every placeholder before you publish.

media.//: named footage slots. src is a path relative to this file; null renders a labelled placeholder ('placeholder: <label>' in frame), never a fake shot.

//voice: optional: a words.json from whisper or an .srt, plus your recording. proof-film times its camera moves into the gaps of the voice.
//music: a pack bed id (music/manifest.json). A template whose cuts follow the beat (proof-film, beat-edit) takes the bed's BPM from the manifest by itself.
//aspects: each aspect is a RE-LAYOUT, never a crop. ad: 16:9 master + generic re-layout for 9:16 / 1:1 / 4:5. proof-film: 16:9 + its own 9:16 layout. `mp list` shows every template's.
//platforms: for each aspect the first preset of that shape sets the safe zone and the brand-cue deadline

claims.//: claims without a key are the ad's proof lines. A digit in a claim needs a source that says where the number comes from (not 'internal benchmark').
claims.text: Searches the notes you already keep.
Your notes stay on your laptop.

overrides.//: raw CONFIG values per template, for what the shared fields do not cover. An unknown CONFIG path is an error, with a suggestion.

proof-film.//: a proof film wants a light bed (20-36% bass share): keep its own bed and tempo here instead of the ad's
